title: W012 OFFICIAL-Provenance Evidence Governance Remediation Forensic Investigation
status: DESIGN COMPLETE — READY FOR CTO REMEDIATION AUTHORIZATION

summary.root_cause: Migration 046 directly INSERTed 12 supersession provenance records with status = OFFICIAL and verification_evidence_id = NULL. Because trg_check_provenance_status_transition is a BEFORE UPDATE trigger, PostgreSQL kernel accepted the INSERT, leaving the records in an architecturally non-compliant OFFICIAL state without an authoritative evidence pointer.
summary.recommended_path: PATH A: AUTHORIZED UPDATE OF CLASSIFICATION B LIFECYCLE FIELDS
summary.remediation_sql_proposal:
UPDATE public.provenance_records
SET verification_evidence_id = 'e0160000-0000-0000-0000-000000002026'::uuid,
    verified_by = 'CTO / LGD Statewide Export Verification'
WHERE transformation_type = 'pilot_to_statutory_supersession'
  AND verification_evidence_id IS NULL;
